generalAbilities.name: Sandsense
generalAbilities.description: The dust manta can feel the slightest disturbance in nearby sand, granting it the ability to sense other creatures moving through or on top of the same body of sand that it's in. In addition, the dust manta ignores concealment from sandstorms, and they're immune to being Dazzled by sand or other grit.

offensiveAbilities.name: Burrowing Charge
offensiveAbilities.description: The dust manta surges through sand to attack unwary prey. It Burrows up to twice its burrow Speed, then Leaps vertically up to 25 feet high, making a stinger Strike against a creature at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 35 feet of the surface). After the Leap, the dust manta falls to the ground but takes no damage from the fall if it lands on sand.

offensiveAbilities.name: Disappear in Dust
offensiveAbilities.description: The dust manta's sand-colored hide allows it to Hide in sand or any other fine, similarly colored substance even without cover or concealment.

offensiveAbilities.name: Dust Manta Toxin
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 2d4 Poison Damage damage (1 round)

Stage 2 3d4 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 3d4 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 2 (1 round)

Stage 4 4d4 Poison Damage damage and Enfeebled 3 (1 round)

Stage 5 death, and the victim's body disintegrates into dust and can only be brought back via a wish ritual or similarly powerful magic

offensiveAbilities.name: Spray Sand
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dust manta sprays a cloud of sand from its gills in a 30ft Type:burst. All creatures in the cloud become Concealed, and all creatures outside the cloud become concealed to creatures within it. The cloud lasts until the end of the dust manta's next turn. The dust manta can't use Spray Sand again for 1d4 rounds. A non-dust manta creature that enters or starts its turn in the cloud must attempt a DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Dazzled for 1 minute or until it spends an Interact action to wipe the dirt and grit from its eyes. Critical

Failure The creature is Blinded for 1 round, after which it's dazzled for 1 minute or until it spends an Interact action to wipe its eyes.
